title: Ganesha Mathe Banda
desc: When Ganesha gets married to a woman who has a differing outlook on marriage, their ideologies of tradition and modernism clash.

title: Namma Kutumba
desc: A six-year-old boy loses his parents in a car accident prior to their divorce. However, 30 years later, he comes across two youngsters who resemble them and decides to unite them.

title: Chalaki
desc: Due to the demands of their students, a male student is admitted at an all-girls college. But new student Aditya, who dislikes studies, hopes that like in the past, this time too he will be suspended.

title: Aana
desc: A young woman named Anna is kidnapped by a few men who then proceed to torture her. However, Anna's situation takes a turn when a great power possesses her.

title: Orange
desc: After her family disapproves of her love for Prashanth, Radha leaves home. Meanwhile, Santosh arrives at Radha's house and is mistaken for her boyfriend.

title: King of Kotha
desc: Heartbroken on being back-stabbed by his childhood friend, Raju, an influential man, runs away from his hometown, Kotha. Soon, to bring back order in the town, a police officer plots a plan.
